biggest_catch: There is genuinely no direct-deposit, transaction, or balance requirement — just open with promo code CK26X during the promo window — but the bonus takes up to 180 days to arrive and anyone who had VCU checking in the last 12 months is excluded.
catches: Promo code CK26X must be used on the application — without it no bonus.
Offer dates are April 1 through December 31, 2026 — outside that window no bonus.
There is no direct deposit, transaction, or minimum-balance requirement.
Bonus is deposited within 180 days of account opening (slow).
Account must be open, at least $0, in good standing, and without pending court orders at payout.
Excludes primary owners of an open VCU personal checking account or one closed within the prior 12 months.
One bonus per household; cannot be combined with another checking offer.
IRS reporting applies to the bonus.
Missouri/Illinois membership context (St. Louis metro credit union); this is Vantage Credit Union of St. Louis, not Vantage Bank or the forex company.
